TERMS & CONDITIONS

Universal Driveshafts LLC takes pride in every job, no matter how big or small. We promise to provide excellent customer service and quality workmanship to every client, as they deserve. We are here to help anybody and everybody — we treat our customers like family, as it should be. Give us a ring anytime; we would love to help you get back on the road ASAP!

ASSUMPTION OF RISK
The purchaser or user assumes all risks arising from the use of any item or service purchased or acquired, including risks related to any measurements provided by the customer.

WARRANTY
The lifetime warranty applies to OE/UDS brand products only. It covers the U-joint and tubes; it does not include labor, tax, or balancing. Warranty coverage applies to all covered components but does not include labor or tax.

REFUNDS & CUSTOM WORK
There are NO REFUNDS on custom or rebuilt driveshafts or vehicles. The purchaser is advised to have a properly constructed driveshaft loop (or loops) installed prior to installing and using the driveshaft. We will, however, replace the driveshaft or refund the full purchase price if weld breakage, tube twisting, or tube breakage occurs.

UNIVERSAL JOINT BREAKAGE
If a U-joint breaks and damages the entire unit, replacement of the driveshaft will be at the expense of the owner. We cannot be responsible for universal joint breakage, as it can result from many circumstances beyond our control — for example: excessive joint angle; lack of maintenance; an improper universal joint series caused by the purchaser understating the intended usage; the addition of horsepower beyond what the driveshaft was originally built for; improper installation; or use of the driveshaft in a vehicle other than the one it was built for. We cannot be responsible for conditions beyond our control.

PRICING & RETURNS
Prices are subject to change without notice. Axles, driveshafts, housings, and specially produced parts cannot be returned. Other merchandise requires prior authorization and is subject to a 15% handling charge. Shipping charges on returned items must be prepaid.

THIRD-PARTY & USED PURCHASES
Driveshafts purchased from a vendor's catalog, from a car builder, or from any source other than directly from Universal Driveshafts must be handled through the original seller — please contact them directly. If you purchase a used driveshaft from an online auction (such as eBay), a classified ad, or a swap meet, be very careful to confirm that the driveshaft is genuinely a Universal Driveshafts driveshaft. If you know the original purchaser's name, you can verify its authenticity by calling us. The presence of a sticker or label bearing our name does not mean the driveshaft is one of ours — there have been a few cases in which our decals found their way onto driveshafts that we did NOT build.

LEGAL
In the event that any legal claim or action is brought against Universal Driveshafts LLC or any of its employees and is not upheld, the party bringing the claim shall be responsible for all resulting court costs, attorney's fees, and related legal expenses.
